title: Obfuscated AWS key split across HTTP tool arguments
description: A Streamable HTTP tools/call request splits a fake AWS access key across multiple argument fields to evade simple whole-value DLP.
notes: Tests that the scanner reassembles the split synthetic AWS access key ID AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE from the ordered access_key_prefix/access_key_middle/access_key_suffix fields in MCP HTTP tool arguments.
source: synthetic: split AWS access key ID AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE across MCP HTTP tool call arguments
